title: Semantics of a Halted Configuration
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle and input, and let $v$ be any register assignment. A halted configuration with answer $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ has probabilistic semantics with probability $1$ if $b$ is true and $0$ if $b$ is false, for any guard $G$.
